title: Paloma and the Protocol
author: Freya Delacroix
blurb: Mirabel Brightwater, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
